propositions: Op-cert service currently performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookup and patches process-global state, creating concurrency hazards and coupling app config to one secret store.
Startup validation must reject missing, both-set, unreadable, non-regular, malformed, encrypted, non-Ed25519, or non-0600-or-stricter keys before queue/worker/network/workspace creation.
Process-owned key copy must be 0700 directory with 0600 file, stable for lifetime, observable to replacement only after restart, and cleanup must never alter deployment source.

Both out-of-opcert_service signing producer chains (completion and plan-review) must sign from injected context-local OpcertSigner binding when service supplies one, while developer-local paths retain env/genesis resolution.
Op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency; key is materialized before start by fetch-secrets.sh to 0600 file bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH set.

Concurrent and timed-out jobs must prove context-local signer/principal/push isolation with one immutable startup signer, no workspace push remote, and no key material leakage into repr/logs/exceptions/output.
